text:
maria-ops: Noticed a failure pattern during warm-pool onboarding in eu-central-3 since 09:05 UTC. New nodes never move past 'decrypting artifacts' and then get terminated. Anyone on call?
thomas-infra: I see repeated TCP errors to our keystore range from the bootstrap logs. FW rollout fw-18077 landed at 09:03 as part of egress-hardening.
june-sre: sample from kubelet on a dead node:
```
2026-03-24T09:07:12Z kubelet: decrypt artifact failed: KMS_HTTP_ERROR: Post "https://keystore.eu-central-3.internal/": dial tcp 10.45.6.9:443: connect: connection refused
```
thomas-infra: fw-18077 denies 10.45.0.0/16 egress (we intended to block third-party analytics). Looks like keystore sits in that block.
nate-sec: We pushed a baseline default-deny egress to reduce blast radius for exfil. We approved known collector carveouts but I missed the internal keystore CIDR mapping. My bad.
maria-ops: This is blocking ~40 node joins across three AZs. Autoscaler is retrying with short backoff; we're burning provisioning cycles. Can we open a narrow exception until we fix the CIDR mapping?
june-sre: Recommend temporary rule add vs full rollback. If we open auditshipper range too that's riskier. We need just keystore hostnames/ips.
thomas-infra: I can add allowlist for keystore IP range. Command I'll run: `cloud-fw update fw-18077 --allow 10.45.0.0/16:443 --comment "temp allow for keystore onboarding"` Will wait for sec signoff.
deploy-bot: Change request queued by thomas-infra at 2026-03-24T09:18:05Z. Change id ch-9127.
nate-sec: Approve targeted allow for 10.45.0.0/16:443 only. No broad auditshipper opens. Make sure the change is logged with ticket ref.
thomas-infra: Patch applied: ch-9127 completed at 09:20:30Z.
maria-ops: After patch: nodes started to progress. One joined at 09:21:44, another at 09:22:10. Warm pool recovered slowly, by 09:35 we regained capacity.
june-sre: Will collect retry counts and delta cost for churn. Early look: ~9 failed attempts per AZ, approx +0.6 GPU-hours wasted.
nate-sec: Follow-ups: 1) Create RFC to migrate keystore to privatelink or internal service endpoint so egress policies can remain strict. 2) Update deployment checklist to include keystore reachability test. 3) Add an automated preflight that verifies keystore IP->service mapping before egress baseline changes. I'll open the tickets.
maria-ops: Also please adjust autoscaler backoff to exponential with jitter on decrypt errors to avoid repeated provisioning loops.
thomas-infra: Will change autoscaler config and note it in the changelog.
deploy-bot: ch-9127 logged and linked to incident #ecc-keystore-egress (created). Postmortem tracking initiated.
june-sre: Closing here after postmortem writeup. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
